privacy.heading: About this notice
privacy.body: This notice describes information handled through the Suman Entertainment & Media corporate website. The Abhijat Marathi streaming service and app stores have their own privacy notices. Follow their notices when using those services.

privacy.heading: Information you share
privacy.body: Contact forms collect the name, email address, message and any optional phone number, company or subject you provide. Career applications also collect application details and an uploaded résumé. Newsletter registration collects your email address. Please avoid including unrelated sensitive information in messages or files.

privacy.heading: Technical information and preferences
privacy.body: Website requests can include technical information such as IP address, browser details and the referring page. Security checks and rate limits help protect forms against abuse. Language preferences may be remembered using a cookie. Your browser controls let you manage cookies, although some preferences may then need to be selected again.

privacy.heading: How information is used
privacy.body: Information submitted through the website is used to respond to enquiries, assess proposals and applications, manage requested newsletter subscriptions, operate the website and protect it from misuse. A contact enquiry is separate from a newsletter subscription.

privacy.heading: Service providers and embedded content
privacy.body: Hosting, database, file-storage and security providers support website operations. Embedded videos and external links may connect your browser to services such as YouTube or app stores, which process information under their own policies. Opening a store link takes you outside this website.

privacy.heading: Retention and security
privacy.body: Information may need to be retained to handle your request, maintain relevant business records, resolve issues or meet applicable obligations. Retention depends on the purpose and record involved. Access controls and security measures help protect information, but no internet transmission or storage system is completely risk-free.

privacy.heading: Your choices and requests
privacy.body: Contact us to ask about information you submitted, request a correction or deletion, or stop receiving a newsletter. Describe your request without sending passwords or identity documents in the initial message. We may need to verify a request before acting on it, and applicable record-keeping obligations may limit deletion.

privacy.heading: Contact and changes
privacy.body: Use the contact form for privacy questions or requests and include Privacy request as the subject. This notice may change when website features or information practices change; the updated date identifies the current version.
